rationale: Correct Longroad Energy's ownership ledger by removing two erroneous Morrison/Infratil rows and recording the four current economic ownership groups. Infratil's March 2026 reporting supports a 42.5% economic interest, while its live page reports 42.0%; the live page also reports New Zealand Super Fund at 34.8%, Longroad management at 13.0% and Munich Re at 9.7%. Morrison is Infratil's manager and adviser rather than a beneficial owner. MEAG manages Munich Re's interest through MR Hunu LP. No later company-level owner exit or signed ownership change was identified through September 1, 2026.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Longroad Energy Holdings, LLC develops, owns and operates utility-scale wind, solar and battery-storage projects across the United States. The company was founded in 2016 and serves utilities, corporations and wholesale power markets through a development-to-ownership model that combines contracted offtake, asset management and project-level financing. Current economic ownership is held by Infratil, New Zealand Super Fund, Munich Re and Longroad management. Infratil reported a 42.5% economic interest at March 31, 2026, while its current investment page reports 42.0%; the same page reports New Zealand Super Fund at 34.8%, Longroad management at 13.0% and Munich Re at 9.7%. Morrison manages or advises the Infratil and New Zealand Super Fund investments but is not itself recorded as a beneficial owner. MEAG manages Munich Re's interest through MR Hunu LP. No later company-level owner exit or signed ownership change was identified through September 1, 2026.

set.event: Infratil and New Zealand Super Fund closed their investment in Longroad at 45% each, with management holding 10%; Morrison managed the two institutional investments.
Longroad announced a US$500 million equity round led by MEAG for Munich Re alongside additional Infratil and New Zealand Super Fund capital.
The MEAG-led financing closed, adding Munich Re as a beneficial owner through MR Hunu LP while Infratil, New Zealand Super Fund and management remained invested.
